text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...!
You're really good at this, Trainer.
choice_data_list: One portion wouldn't be enough for your two sisters, would it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
Watching you play gave me the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The ones meant as gifts for my little sisters,
I shall win with my own hands."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: So, may I please have the Paka Petite plushie you won?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I just... wanted to keep proof by my side of everything you worked so hard for...
